scripts.clean:web-cache: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const path=require('node:path'); const base=path.join(process.cwd(),'apps','web'); ['.next','.next-dev','tsconfig.tsbuildinfo'].forEach((name)=>{const target=path.join(base,name); fs.rmSync(target,{recursive:true,force:true}); console.log('removed', target);});"
scripts.dev:live: concurrently -k -n web,worker -c blue,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run live:worker"
